effects: The signer sends `assets` USDC from their wallet to the vault (safeTransferFrom caller -> vault).
The receiver gets newly minted vault shares; the number depends on the share price after fees accrue.
The vault first mints fee shares to the fee receivers (accrueInterest), which dilutes holders a little.
formats.shown: Deposit X USDC into the vault, with the share recipient named.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets; the share price sets the number
findings.evidence: ERC4626Upgradeable.deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` uses totalAssets/totalSupply from storage. The descriptor has no shares field.

effects: The signer pays previewMint(shares) USDC to the vault. The share price sets this amount and nothing caps it except the signer's allowance and balance.
The receiver gets exactly `shares` vault shares.
Fee shares go to the fee receivers first (accrueInterest).
formats.shown: Mint N vault shares for the receiver, paid in USDC at an amount set by the share price.

findings.title: mint does not show the USDC amount the signer pays; the contract computes it from the share price
findings.evidence: ERC4626Upgradeable.mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. Descriptor field 'Pays in (amount set by share price)' shows only 'USDC'.

effects: The vault burns previewWithdraw(assets) shares from the owner.
When the caller is not the owner, it spends the owner's share allowance to the caller.
The receiver gets `assets` USDC.
formats.shown: Withdraw X USDC to the receiver from the owner's shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares it burns; the share price sets the number
findings.evidence: ERC4626Upgradeable.withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); _withdraw(...)` then `_burn(owner, shares)`. The descriptor has no shares field.

effects: The vault burns `shares` shares from the owner and spends the caller's allowance when the caller is not the owner.
The receiver gets previewRedeem(shares) USDC; the share price sets the amount.
formats.shown: Redeem N shares of the owner to the receiver.

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount the receiver gets; the share price sets it
findings.evidence: ERC4626Upgradeable.redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); _withdraw(...)` then `safeTransfer(asset(), receiver, assets)`. The descriptor has no assets field.

effects: Sets the signer's vault-share allowance for the spender to `value` (max uint means unlimited).
formats.shown: Approve N (or Unlimited) vault shares for the spender.

formats.key: permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 deadline,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: Sets the owner's vault-share allowance for the spender to `value`, using the owner's signature, valid until the deadline. The submitter's assets do not move.
formats.shown: Submit a share permit: owner, spender, amount and deadline.

effects: Sets the vault deposit cap to `newLimit` USDC. The cap applies only when isDepositLimit is on.
formats.shown: Set the deposit limit to X USDC.

effects: Turns the depositor whitelist on or off. When on, only whitelisted callers can deposit.
Turns the deposit cap on or off.
Adds `account` to the depositor whitelist or removes it.
formats.shown: Update the whitelist for the account, with membership Included or Excluded in a field.

findings.title: setDepositorWhitelistStatus intent does not say whether the account is added or removed
findings.evidence: Descriptor interpolatedIntent "Update whitelist for {account}"; the direction is only in field `#.newStatus` 'Whitelist membership'. VaultV2.setDepositorWhitelistStatus: `isDepositorWhitelisted[account] = newStatus;`

effects: Accrues and mints pending fee shares to the old receivers.
Sets the per-second management fee (1e18 = 100%) and the address that gets future management fee shares.
formats.shown: Set the management fee as a percentage per second, and the fee recipient.

findings.title: setManagementFee interpolated intent leaves out the new fee recipient
setManagementFee shows a per-second rate such as 0.0000000317%, which is hard to read
findings.evidence: Case 75 renders '0.0000000317097919%'. IVaultV2: `MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE = 5e16 / uint96(365 days)`. No format can convert it to a yearly rate.

effects: Accrues and mints pending fee shares to the old receivers.
Sets the performance fee on interest (1e18 = 100%, max 20%) and the address that gets future performance fee shares.
formats.shown: Set the performance fee as a percentage, and the fee recipient.

findings.title: setPerformanceFee interpolated intent leaves out the new fee recipient

effects: Gives `role` on the vault to `account`.
formats.shown: Grant a named role (or a raw ID) to the account.

findings.title: grantRole shows an unknown role as a long decimal number next to its hex ID
findings.evidence: Case 84: Role '101927306990285036672089535667814214604366950803309463610350329571329499119003', Role ID '0xe158cf...bd9b'. The enum `$.metadata.enums.roles` covers only the seven roles of VaultV2.

effects: Removes `role` on the vault from `account`.
formats.shown: Revoke the named role from the account.

effects: The signer gives up its own `role` on the vault (callerConfirmation must equal the signer).
formats.shown: Renounce the named role for the role holder.

effects: Makes `newOwner` the Ownable owner of the vault; the signer loses ownership.
formats.shown: Transfer vault ownership to the new owner.

effects: Mints accrued management, performance and protocol fee shares to their receivers and updates the cached protocol fee. Nothing of the signer moves.
